questions.question: What does Zechariah 12 say God will make Jerusalem to the surrounding peoples?
options: A burning lamp and a shining crown
A refreshing spring and a fruitful vine
A cup of staggering and a heavy stone
A strong tower and a sheltering rock
questions.answer: A cup of staggering and a heavy stone

questions.question: What striking prophecy about mourning appears in Zechariah 12?
options: They will rebuild the temple in glory
They will be scattered among the peoples
They will rise up and drive out all of the nations
They will look on him whom they pierced and mourn
questions.answer: They will look on him whom they pierced and mourn

questions.question: Zechariah 12 says God will pour out a spirit of grace and pleas for mercy on the house of David.
They will look on me, on him whom they have _____, and they shall mourn.
I will make Jerusalem a heavy _____ for all the peoples.
